typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BATCH_ID as string,
		BLEI_CK as string,
		BLIV_ID as string,
		BLBL_DUE_DT as timestamp,
		BLSH_INVOICE_DTM as timestamp,
		FACETS_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		FIS_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		IS_RECYCLED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBREADDETAILEDTABLE
SRCOLEDBREADDETAILEDTABLE derive(DC_IS_RECYCLED = toString(IS_RECYCLED),
		DC_FIS_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(FIS_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE = toString(IS_REVERSAL_INVOICE),
		DC_VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_FACETS_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(FACETS_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_GRGR_ID = toString(GRGR_ID),
		DC_BLIV_ID = toString(BLIV_ID)) ~> DCDETAILEDFIELDS
DCDETAILEDFIELDS sort(desc(DC_IS_RECYCLED, false),asc(BLEI_CK, false)) ~> SRTDETAILEDFIELDS
